description: Security headers attached to the Logjam frontend CloudFront distribution. Source of truth for the CSP rolled out via CloudFront → Policies → Response headers (policy name: logjam-frontend-security-headers). When the allowlist changes (new map tile host, new API origin, etc.), update this file AND the AWS Console policy.
rolloutStrategy: Ship initially as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only for ~1 week. Watch browser console + (optional) report-uri endpoint. Swap to Content-Security-Policy (enforcing) once no violations remain.

placeholders.<FRONTEND_ORIGIN>: Production frontend origin (used for connect-src in case of fetch back to same host)
placeholders.<MAPLIBRE_TILE_HOSTS>: Space-separated list of basemap tile hosts (e.g. https://tiles.maptiler.com https://api.maptiler.com). Enumerate from frontend/src/components/map/ style sources before applying.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.cloudfront.net https://*.s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com <MAPLIBRE_TILE_HOSTS>; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' <API_ORIGIN> https://cognito-idp.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com https://*.auth.ap-southeast-2.amazoncognito.com https://*.cloudfront.net https://*.s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com <MAPLIBRE_TILE_HOSTS>; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

applySteps: AWS Console → CloudFront → Policies → Response headers → Create policy
Add the four sibling headers above as custom headers
For initial rollout, add Content-Security-Policy as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only
Attach policy to the frontend distribution's default behavior
After clean week, swap header name from Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only to Content-Security-Policy
notes: 'unsafe-inline' for style-src is required by MUI/emotion's runtime style injection. Never relax script-src to 'unsafe-inline'.
geolocation=(self) is intentional — the app uses device location to place canyon trip logs.
frame-ancestors 'none' only works as a real header (not <meta http-equiv>) — hence CloudFront delivery, not index.html injection.
